main_issue: Who covers Agent D's unfinished analysis section before Thursday's pitch, and whether the deadline can be extended or scope simplified

A-B.evidence: A insists everyone must stretch and the 'if' is over (15, 21); B says she can't take more (14, 16, 22) and asks for an extension or simplification (24); A rejects it: 'No. We cannot ask for an extension' (26).

A-C.evidence: C first backs A: 'He's right' (5), but then refuses the data/charts and Anil work (17, 19), and in 25 sides with B on an extension; A says 'No' (26).

A-D.evidence: D agrees to hand over the work (8), and A plans to take the main analysis after the handover (13). D asks 'no one can take the work?' (20) and A keeps pushing without an extension (21, 26). D takes no position on an extension.

B-C.evidence: Both say they have no capacity (10, 11). C then backs B's extension idea: 'I agree, can we ask for an extension?' (25).

B-D.evidence: D never addresses B's position. D's 'So... no one can take the work?' (20) only echoes the shared problem, and D says nothing on the extension.

C-D.evidence: D's remark (20) comes after C's refusals (17, 19), but D takes no stance on C's extension request (25).
